summary: Sandbach United are in great shape ahead of the 26/27 season kicking off next week, having welcomed some exciting new signings and a returning player to bolster the squad. The Ramblers showed promise in a competitive friendly against St Helens, though will be looking to tighten things up defensively, and they're also sporting three brand new kits this season while actively seeking sponsorship opportunities. With just seven days until the campaign begins, now's the perfect time for supporters to get behind the team in their promotion push!
